notes: Company background: RTB platform serving ads to mobile web + connected TV. High QPS bursts during bid windows; strict SLA on tail latency.
Primary contact: CTO Arun Mehta; Head of ML ops: Clara Nguyen.
Why Redwood: interested in unified runtime for hosted->dedicated->on-prem so production inference is consistent across regions and partners.
Perf targets from call: p95 generation latency <= 40ms for 128-token ranking model; sustained throughput target 8k req/s during peak (burst to 30k for <10s).
Cost/ops constraints: want cost per 1k inferences <= $0.25 (model + infra) to keep CPM economics; very cost-sensitive on embeddings/rerank calls that run millions/day.

Model preferences: currently running a distilled Llama-2 variant (7B) for reranking; open to 4-bit quantization if latency/accuracy trade-offs are small. Also exploring small embedding model for user vectors.
Tech requirements: VPC private control plane, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency in us-east-1 for EU inventory partners not required now.
Routing/fallback: must have automatic fallback to lower-latency variant during capacity constraints; can accept slightly lower quality but not >10% uplift in mis-ranks.
Batching/caching interest: ask for intelligent prefix caching for repeated auction contexts; eager batching during micro-batches but cannot push tail latency beyond 5ms per-request.

Benchmark asks: see attached perf plan — tests needed: (1) baseline hosted vs dedicated, (2) quantized 4-bit vs fp16, (3) batching sensitivity with 1-32 batch sizes, (4) KV-cache hit rate simulations.
Quote from CTO: 'If quantization saves 30% infra cost without raising p99 above 100ms, we can move to dedicated capacity.'
POC plan agreed on 2025-02-18: 2-week sandbox on Redwood Dedicated, synthetic RTB load replay + telemetry export to Datadog; SE to run benchmark and hand off cost model.

Current blockers: legal reviewing private deployment legal terms; security needs 'encryption at rest' topology diagram before on-prem trial; also want a simple performance guarantee in pilot agreement.
Sales/ops notes: AE (Priya) to deliver proposal with two SKUs (Dedicated reserved monthly + Optimize add-on). Build slide comparing per-1k cost across 3 quantization profiles.
SE notes (Ethan): prioritize kernels that reduce dispatch overhead; suggested testing FP16 + int4 quantization chain and measuring KV cache warm-up time.
Metrics they will evaluate: p50/p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k reqs, model quality delta (NDCG@10) after quantization, prefix cache hit ratio under realistic auction patterns.
Next immediate: schedule perf run week of 2025-03-10; provide sandbox credentials and sample replay dataset (50M requests anonymized).
Internal ask: loop in Optimize PM for recommended batching config and expected savings; attach Redwood Optimize proposal template to Drive link.
Follow ups: legal + security sync on 2025-03-04 (FF call), SE deep dive on quantization on 2025-03-06.
